note: Ckeditor5 HTML Embed is a thin CKEditor 5 integration (no PHP). It provides a CKEditor 5 plugin definition (ckeditor_html_embed.ckeditor5.yml) registering the JS plugin htmlEmbed.HtmlEmbed, a toolbar item 'htmlEmbed' (label 'HTML Embed'), the elements <div> and <div class="raw-html-embed">, and htmlEmbed.showPreviews=false. It is enabled per text format by adding 'htmlEmbed' to that format's CKEditor 5 toolbar, stored at editor.editor.<format> -> settings.toolbar.items. No configure route, no permissions, no Drush, no config schema, no public plugin types; depends on core ckeditor5. Medium cases read a live editor's toolbar; hard cases require adding the htmlEmbed toolbar item, verified against editor.editor config. Fixtures create namespaced chte_* formats and delete them in cleanup/reset.

evals.prompt: I enabled the Ckeditor5 HTML Embed module. How do I actually let editors embed raw HTML in a given text format, and what is the toolbar button called?
evals.expected_output: There is no settings page. Edit the text format at Text formats and editors, and drag the 'HTML embed' button into that format's CKEditor 5 toolbar (toolbar item id 'htmlEmbed'), then Save. The choice is stored on editor.editor.<format> under settings.toolbar.items.

evals.prompt: Which CKEditor 5 JavaScript plugin does the Ckeditor5 HTML Embed module enable, and are HTML previews shown or is the raw source shown in the editor?
evals.expected_output: It enables CKEditor 5's htmlEmbed.HtmlEmbed plugin. The module sets htmlEmbed.showPreviews to false, so the editor shows the raw HTML source rather than a rendered preview.

evals.prompt: For the Ckeditor5 HTML Embed module, which HTML elements does the plugin declare it produces, and which core module is it dependent on?
evals.expected_output: The plugin declares the elements <div> and <div class="raw-html-embed">. The module depends on core's ckeditor5 module. If the format's allowed-HTML filter is on, add the tags you want editors to embed.

evals.prompt: On this site, which text format has the CKEditor 5 HTML embed button enabled in its toolbar? Inspect the live editor configuration and name the format (machine name).
evals.expected_output: The format chte_med (label 'CHTE Med') has 'htmlEmbed' in editor.editor.chte_med settings.toolbar.items.

evals.prompt: The text format 'CHTE Med2' (machine name chte_med2) on this site lets editors embed raw HTML. Inspect its live CKEditor 5 configuration and give the exact toolbar item id that provides the HTML embed feature.
evals.expected_output: The toolbar item id is 'htmlEmbed' - present in editor.editor.chte_med2 settings.toolbar.items alongside heading and link.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site there is a CKEditor 5 text format 'CHTE Hard' (machine name chte_hard) whose toolbar does not yet include the HTML embed button. Using the Ckeditor5 HTML Embed module, add the HTML embed button to that format's CKEditor 5 toolbar. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add 'htmlEmbed' to editor.editor.chte_hard settings.toolbar.items and save (e.g. via the format's toolbar UI or Editor::setSettings()). Verify checks 'htmlEmbed' is in the toolbar items.

evals.prompt: Editors using the 'CHTE Hard2' text format on this site need to be able to paste raw HTML embed codes (like an iframe or a widget snippet) directly into the body. Right now they can't. Turn on that ability for this format. Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: Add the HTML embed button ('htmlEmbed') to editor.editor.chte_hard2 settings.toolbar.items and save. Verify checks 'htmlEmbed' is present in the toolbar items.
